name: psram_lvgl
title: LVGL touch demo
description: LVGL v9 running as a PSRAM app: drawn at half the chosen canvas and scaled 2x (1024x600 or 800x480), GT911 touch, exit with the physical X button.
author: LVGL; P4 port by giltal
about: A small LVGL v9 app with touch widgets, drawn at half the canvas size and scaled 2x: 512x300 on the whole 1024x600 panel, or 400x240 on the classic 800x480 canvas (Screen setting). A quick way to check that the display, touch and the PAPP loader work.
changelog:
0.2.0: uses the canvas size from the store's Screen setting (whole panel by default); the layout grows with it
0.1.1: rebuilt with the IDF 6.1 toolchain
controls: Touch: tap and drag the widgets
Slider: sets the bar and dial
Switch: pause / resume the live graph
Paddle wheel: drives the gauge and graph
